features: Massive 20000mAh Capacity- Stay powered throughout the day with a 20000mAh (74Wh) Li-Polymer battery, ideal for charging smartphones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices multiple times.
22.5W Fast Charging - Supports up to 22.5W fast charging through both USB-A and USB Type-C output ports, delivering efficient charging for compatible devices.
Dual Input & Dual Output - Recharge the power bank via Micro USB or USB Type-C, and charge two devices simultaneously using the USB-A and USB Type-C output ports.

Advanced Safety Protection - Built with a premium Li-Polymer battery and multiple protection features against overcharging, over-current, over-voltage, overheating, and short circuits for safe everyday use
Portable & Travel Friendly -Slim and compact design fits easily into your backpack or travel bag. Includes a USB Type-C charging cable and is backed by a 2-Year Carry-in Warranty.
description: Power your devices wherever you go with the EVM EnTurbo 20000mAh Power Bank (EVM P0204). Featuring a 74Wh Li-Polymer battery, it delivers dependable backup power for smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices. With 22.5W fast charging, the EnTurbo charges compatible devices quickly through both USB-A and USB Type-C output ports. Dual input options (Micro USB and USB Type-C) offer flexible recharging, while dual outputs allow you to power two devices at the same time.Designed for portability, the compact body is easy to carry during travel, work, or daily commuting. Built-in safety features help protect your devices from overcharging, overheating, over-current, over-voltage, and short circuits.The package includes the EnTurbo Power Bank, a USB Type-C cable, and a user manual. Backed by a 2-Year Carry-in Warranty from EVM.
